title: Conference & Live Event Filming
description: Low-profile multi-camera crews capturing live conference stages, executive keynotes, and fast-turnaround event highlights across Cambridge and London.
seoTitle: Conference & Event Filming | Cambridge & London | FilmEditRun
seoDescription: Multi-camera conference filming and live event video capture across Cambridge and London. Full session keynote masters and fast 48h social highlight reels.
heroLead: Conferences spark ideas. We make sure they don't stay in the room. Operating with low-profile crews across Cambridge and London, we capture every keynote and panel, delivering edited sessions and fast-turnaround social films while your event is trending.
breakdownBody: Operating with scale and efficiency across your venue and AV, our crews ensure speakers feel at ease. Configured for single or multi-camera setups, we live mix presentation slides and camera angles to reduce post-production turnaround and deliver fast.

deliverables.title: Synchronized Keynote & Panel Masters
deliverables.description: Multi-camera 4K recordings of every stage presentation, synchronized with presentation slide decks and clean direct soundboard feeds for on-demand streaming across your corporate channels.

deliverables.title: Fast-Turnaround Social Highlight Films
deliverables.description: High-energy recap films delivered within 24 to 48 hours, cut to licensed music with on-screen titles to share the buzz on LinkedIn while your event is still trending.

deliverables.title: Speaker Soundbites & Attendee Vox Pops
deliverables.description: On-the-floor delegate reactions and brief executive soundbites captured between sessions, creating an authentic library of quotes and cutaways for press releases and next year's ticket launch.

ctaDescription: Tell us about your event dates, venue location, and technical brief. We'll outline a dependable setup and provide a clear quote.
